events.title: Earthwork Music Collective ft. Joe Reilly, Nicholas james Thomasma, Sari Brown
events.summary: Earthwork Music Collective believes in the intrinsic power of music to raise both community and self-awareness. Comprised of musicians, teachers, healers, farmers, water protectors, and community organizers, they encourage cooperation and collaboration, using music as a tool to serve, heal, inspire and empower. Hosted by washboardist-at-large Vince Russo, this monthly series features members from all around MI converging to create cosmic collabs, cultivate lasting relationships with our community, and elevate environmental and social justice movements. This month’s show will feature performances by Joe Reilly, Nicholas James Thomasma, & Sari Brown

legacySeriesKeys: code switch: distributing blackness, reprogramming internet art|museum of contemporary art detroit (mocad)
events.title: Code Switch: Distributing Blackness, Reprogramming Internet Art
events.summary: Code Switch: Distributing Blackness, Reprogramming Internet Art is a multi-sited exhibition exploring and redefining the history of 'Black data,' centering contributions by artists of African descent to new media art and digital practice. It builds on a historic archival timeline of radical visions from Black makers and brings together contemporary artists to examine the relationship between body and machine in the context of cybercultures and technology.
